moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio lp-conic, written here): Ring (outer r 50, 8 px band) filled with a conic gradient: accent -> yellow at 30 % -> transparent at 60 % -> accent; the gradient's start angle turns 0 -> 360 deg every 2000 ms linear, looping seamlessly. Params: radius (50 px) · width (8 px) · period (2 s) · colors. A conic gradient accent → yellow (30 %) → transparent (60 %) → accent whose start angle turns.
